text:
sara: Quick alert from canary run for raven-lite-int8. Structured-output monitor flagged ~1.76% of responses where the parser failed because the key "tool_calls" was split across streaming chunks (e.g. "too
 l_calls"). Seen mostly with streaming chunk=32 and prompts that end with fenced code.

omar: Oof. sample raw fragment (flattened token capture):
```
..., "request_id":"r-221","to
ol_calls": [ {"name": "fetch_price","args": {"sku":"A1"}} ], "action":"invoke_tool" ...
```
Parser fails because it expects exact token "tool_calls".

li: Correlates from mirrors: int8 streaming chunk=32: 15/850 = 1.76%. int8 non-streaming: 0.03%. fp16-streaming chunk=32: 0.14%. Also higher when prompt suffix is a JSON example or triple-backtick block.

infra-bot: Canary summary: raven-lite-int8-stream (region-us-east) 15/850 problematic = 1.7647%. Mirror baseline fp16-stream: 1/720 = 0.1389%. Details: https://redwood.internal/canary/1823456789

hannah: Short-term fix ideas: a conservative parser "reviver" that coalesces fragmented bareword keys by stripping inter-token whitespace/newline when the resulting bareword matches one of the expected schema keys (action, tool_calls, result). Also case-insensitive matching. Log whenever reviver triggers.

sara: Agreed. We should be strict: only coalesce if it yields an exact expected key and structural neighbors look like JSON (following colon and either array/object). Add metric tag reviver=coalesce-v1 and a false_positive counter if post-call validation fails. Rollout at 3% initially.

omar: I'll draft the patch. Also file INF-8701: retain raw-token dumps + reassembled candidate for 48h for any reviver-triggered cases. We need the tokens for kernel bisect.

li: For longer term, I'll run kernel and chunking sweep: q8a, q4_0, q5_k variants; streaming chunk sizes 16/32/64; with and without warmup. Use dataset /datasets/struct-onboard-suffixes. Expect initial run EOD.

sara: Good. Also add a small regression eval that injects near-miss cases (split keys, weird casing, extra whitespace) to measure false positive acceptance rate. We must ensure reviver doesn't interpret narrative sentences as keys.

infra-bot: Deploy queued: reviver-coalesce-v1 -> 4 nodes. Canary id rlv1-1823.

omar: I'll post the patch link and the initial 1k-request canary metrics back here when available. If we see any increase in false positives, we will throttle immediately.

sara: Thanks — assigning follow-ups: OMAR -> patch + INF-8701, LI -> kernel sweep, HANNAH -> metric dashboards (funcall_accept_rate{cohort,reviver}, reviver_false_positive).
